subtitle: Special Subject - Foreign Languages(Global Englishes)
courseType: （全課程からの提供）リベラルアーツ系科目文理横断
teachers: カパティ　マウィルマラグマン
educationalGoal:
学習・教育目標
In Global Englishes, students will explore global uses of English, focusing on Jap
an. Students build vocabulary, listening, and speaking skills while learning how E
nglish reflects culture. They gain confidence communicating in international and i
ntercultural contexts.
advice:
This course helps students learn how English is used in different countries and cultures. Students will study di
fferent English accents, local vocabulary, and how to speak in a culturally appropriate way.

The course will focus on:

a) Varieties of English around the world
b) Common expressions in different countries
c) Listening and speaking using global media
d) Communicative strategies for real situations

Students will practice English through discussions, role-plays, and presentations. They will learn how to use En
glish in international situations and become more confident speaking with people from other cultures.

Before each class, students must study materials provided by the teacher.
